summary: Request: Rolling audit snapshots (every 6h) + tenant access inventory mapping for SIEM ingestion and KMS rotation proof
description:
Issue summary:
Customer requests a recurring, rolling snapshot delivery of ordered audit events (every 6 hours) for a defined tenancy scope (NimbleBank account) to their SIEM. They also want an itemized tenant access inventory mapping included in each snapshot (list of Redwood users/service principals with last-used timestamp and role), plus cryptographic proof that the KMS encryption key used to sign the manifest rotated according to our rotation schedule for the window.

Impact:
- Customer cannot complete their weekly compliance attestation without periodic snapshots and access inventory (audit evidence).
- They require cryptographic proof of key rotation for retention policy audits.

Environment:
- Production account (NimbleBank tenant), region us-east, Redwood hosted control plane and S3 export delivery.

Requested deliverables:
1) Rolling snapshot export containing ordered events for the tenant every 6 hours for a rolling 30-day window. Each snapshot should include a manifest with per-file SHA256 checksums and a signature from the export KMS key.
2) Per-snapshot tenant access inventory CSV (user/service-principal, role, last_auth_timestamp, auth_method).
3) KMS rotation attestation for the signing key used on manifests (previous key id, rotated_at timestamp, rotation-proof signature).
4) Field map for SIEM ingestion mapping Redwood audit fields to NimbleBank Splunk field names and a sample mapping snippet.
5) Resume token support for incremental replay in case a snapshot transfer fails.
6) Documentation snippet showing how to validate the manifest and verify signature and checksum.

Steps to reproduce / request flow:
1) Customer initiates evidence request via Support and provides target S3 bucket config with cross-account role.
2) Support validates tenant scope and creates an export job tied to NimbleBank account.
3) Export job produces periodic snapshot packages to the provided S3 path.

Logs / sample event ids:
- sample-event-ids: 2026-03-09T11:12:23Z:e3f9f5, 2026-03-09T13:41:02Z:4a7b2c, 2026-03-10T02:07:51Z:9f1dbe

Additional ask from customer:
- They want the access inventory to include whether the identity uses MFA or service principal key material, and an annotation for any privileged escalation events during the window.
- They asked for retention lifecycle metadata so they can validate legal-hold windows when we freeze a tenant snapshot for litigation requests.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer provided target S3 bucket arn: arn:aws:s3:::nimblebank-audit-ingest-prod-1 and cross-account role (role/redwood-exporter). 2) Support created initial export job in staging to validate connectivity. 3) Observed manifest signature created with key alias export/manifests-v1. 4) Customer confirmed they could read the first manifest but asked for rotation proof and access inventory in the payload.

Error observed:
- No explicit error; customer requested KMS rotation proof which is not currently included in manifest payloads.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Support (Maya Chen): Received evidence request from NimbleBank security team. They provided S3 bucket and role. Escalating for KMS rotation proof and tenant access inventory support.

2026-03-10 11:03 - SRE (Jordan Li): Verified export job succeeds to customer's S3 bucket. Manifests are signed with export/manifests-v1. Current manifests do not include rotation history; will need to augment exporter to attach rotation metadata or supply separate attestation document.

2026-03-10 15:45 - CS (Evelyn Park): NimbleBank clarified they require per-window rotation proof (previous key id + rotation timestamp) for each manifest; they cannot accept a separate monthly attestation.
investigation_notes: Checked exporter codepath: exporter creates manifest, signs using KMS Sign with key alias and attaches signature and key id (KeyId) currently. No rotation-history recorded. (ref: github exporter/src/manifest.go)

Confirmed KMS key rotation schedules live in KMS alias metadata; request to KMS API for GetKeyRotationStatus returns true for export/manifests-v1. However, to provide previous key id we need to pull CloudTrail event for ReEncrypt or KeyRotationCompleted which we currently don't surface in manifest generation.

Hypothesis: easiest path is to include a small attestation file alongside manifest that enumerates last two key versions and rotation timestamps derived from CloudTrail and internal key-rotation job logs.

Action taken: opened PR to exporter to emit tenant-access-inventory CSV and attestation file (PR #412). Created internal task for SRE to add CloudTrail lookup step in the export pipeline. Slack thread: #support (https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C09AB12F3/p1678458394000000)
Risk/notes: exposing CloudTrail-derived timestamps must be sanitized for cross-account exports; ensure only rotation metadata is surfaced (no raw event bodies).
resolution: Workaround provided: We delivered an initial rolling snapshot package with manifest and signature to customer's S3 path and added a companion file attestation/rotations-20260310.json (contains previous_key_id and rotated_at) as a one-off. Tenant access inventory CSV v1 included in the package. Next steps: merge PR #412 and enable the new exporter code path to produce attestation and inventory for all future snapshots. Target full automation by 2026-03-18. Customer accepted the one-off as interim evidence and flagged follow-up for automation and retention lifecycle headers.
next_steps: Merge exporter PR #412 and deploy to staging (owner: @devops-team)
Add CloudTrail rotation-lookup step to export pipeline and ensure sanitized output (owner: SRE)
Add resume-token resume logic to handle partial uploads and validate with customer test harness (owner: support/exports)
Produce a short validation snippet for customer showing how to verify manifest signature with KMS public key (owner: security)
Schedule follow-up call with NimbleBank on 2026-03-15 to review automated exports and field mapping
